name: PLSC 1125E
title: Insects, Food and Culture
description: Introduction to the fascinating world of insects and their ubiquitous interactions with people. Role of insects in food and fiber production; insects as food; impact of insects on human health, commerce and history; and insects as inspiration sources for art, music, film and literature around the world. CA 4-INT. Formerly offered as SPSS 1125.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
